section.sectionSummaryBrief: The maamar continues that both the influence of a rav and that of a king come specifically through the prior service of the exile period.
section.t: And it continues in the maamar,
that all this
(namely, both the influence of a rav and the influence of a king)
comes specifically through the prior service of the time of exile.
And to understand the connection of the service of the time of exile to the revelation of the Future to Come,
it introduces in the maamar,
that because of the greatness and multitude of concealments and veils in the time of exile,
the primary service in the time of exile is in the manner of victory,
to be strong in the actual fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos in actual deed,
without taking into account any hindrance or obstacle.
For in general, this is the matter of the service of mesirus nefesh that is above intellect and reason,
for the matter of mesirus nefesh is that one does not enter into any consideration or deliberation,
but rather,
that it is absolutely impossible
to be in any other way.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: In the time of the Temple there was sight of G-dliness, but in exile there is a sleep-like concealment, so service is through mesirus nefesh and victory, especially in the ikvesa d’Meshicha era.
section.t: And the explanation is,
that in the time of the Temple, all of Israel were on a lofty level,
for in addition to being people of great comprehension,
behold, during their pilgrimage they also had sight of G-dliness
(which is above comprehension)
as it is stated,
"Three times a year shall appear" etc., and just as one comes to appear, so does one come to see,
but in the time of exile it is written,
"I am asleep," and our sages said,
"in exile,"
for just as in literal sleep all the inner faculties are concealed,
beginning with the faculty of intellect,
for during sleep the faculty of intellect departs and only the faculty of imagination remains,
and the primary concealment
(that comes from sleep)
is in the faculty of sight
(to the extent that this is also evident in the limbs of the body,
for during sleep the eyes are closed),
so too is it with the sleep of exile,
for the primary concealment of exile is that in the time of exile there is no sight of G-dliness,
"Our signs we have not seen,"
and also the comprehension of G-dliness
(which exists even in the time of exile)
is not at all comparable to the comprehension of the time of the Temple,
to the extent that the comprehension of the time of exile
(relative to the comprehension of the time of the Temple)
is analogous to the faculty of imagination in sleep.
And because of this,
also the love and fear
(that are in the time of exile)
are not as they should be.
For in addition to the fact that in the time of exile it is impossible to have the nullification of prostration
(inner nullification)
which comes specifically from the sight of G-dliness,
and as it is stated,
"And we are unable to ascend and appear and prostrate ourselves before You,"
for since we are unable to ascend and appear, consequently we are unable
(also)
to prostrate ourselves, to be in a state of inner nullification,
behold also the external nullification
(the nullification of bowing),
which comes from the comprehension of G-dliness
(which exists,
in general,
also in the time of exile),
is not as it should be,
since even the comprehension of G-dliness in the time of exile is not true comprehension,
and the primary service in the time of exile is in the manner of victory,
as above.
And within the time of exile itself,
behold, from generation to generation the minds and hearts diminish,
as our sages said,
"The heart of the early ones... and we are like the eye of a fine needle,"
and especially in the generation of the heels of Moshiach, when concealments and veils have multiplied
(in addition to the fact that minds have diminished).
Therefore, in this time, the matter of victory and mesirus nefesh that is above intellect and reason is even more relevant.
And even the people of intellect that exist now must set aside their intellect and not go after reason and knowledge
(for from the side of intellect it is possible to deviate, Heaven forbid, from the path of truth,
and especially now that concealments and veils have multiplied,
as above),
but only to stand firm not to deviate, Heaven forbid, from the Shulchan Aruch even as much as the tip of a yud,
service in the manner of victory and mesirus nefesh that is above intellect.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The concealment of exile only affects the inner faculties of the soul, not the attribute of Netzach, whose root is in the essence of the soul and in the innerness of Kesser, and is revealed even more in exile.
section.t: And behold, the reason for this, that the concealment and veiling of exile
(including also the concealment and veiling of the generation of the heels of Moshiach)
is only upon the inner faculties of the soul and not upon the attribute of Netzach,
is explained in the maamar,
that this is because the root of Netzach
is in the essence of the soul,
for so too is it Above,
that the root of Netzach is in the innerness of Kesser,
and in the innerness of Kesser, the matter of change does not apply.
And as it is stated,
"And also the Netzach of Yisrael will not lie and will not relent, for He is not a man to relent,"
for the matter of relenting and change applies only in the aspect of "man,"
[the] chain of descent,
and since the root of Netzach is in the aspect of "not man,"
above the chain of descent,
therefore change does not apply to it,
and it is present in revelation even in the time of exile.
And moreover,
rather, in the time of exile,
and especially in the heels of Moshiach,
the power of victory and mesirus nefesh is in greater revelation than in the time of the Temple.
